lines.1: 「A cruiser! So THAT'S what this is!」
lines.2: With me, Konoe, and the Principal aboard, it sped across the sea.
lines.3: I got a little seasick at first, but adjusted quickly.
lines.5: Konoe narrowed her eyes as her twin-tails fluttered in the wind.
lines.9: 「I mean, I AM having fun, but...」
lines.11: 「The whole point is for YOU to repay me, right? You haven't actually done anything here.」
lines.13: 「Well, the day's only just started. I'll expect something from you later.」
lines.16: 「Wha...? Isn't that the island people get banished to!?」
lines.17: 「Relax. I'm merely making it specially available as your playground.」
lines.18: 「The water is clean and it has plenty of plants and animals. It's a fine island.」
lines.19: The Principal gave us a wicked grin.
lines.20: My bad feeling got even worse.
